children.name: Allotoca goslinei
children.description: Allotoca goslinei, commonly known as the banded allotoca or tiro rayado in Spanish, is a species of fish in the family Goodeidae.

children.name: Allotoca meeki
children.description: Allotoca meeki, commonly known as the Zirahuen allotoca or the tiro de Zirahuén, is a species of fish endemic to Lake Zirahuén, a small endorheic mountain lake in Michoacán state of central Mexico.

children.name: Allotoca zacapuensis
children.description: Allotoca zacapuenis, the Zacapu allotoca, also known in Spanish as tiro de la Laguna de Zacapu, is a species of fish in the Goodeidae family, endemic to Zacapu Lagoon and the Angulo River in Lerma River Basin, Mexico.

children.name: Ilyodon whitei
children.description: The Balsas splitfin (Ilyodon whitei) is a species of fish in the family Goodeidae.

children.name: Xenotoca doadrioi
children.description: Xenotoca doadrioi or San Marcos redtail splitfin is a bony fish species in the goodeid family.

children.name: Xenotoca lyonsi
children.description: Xenotoca lyonsi, the Tamazula redtail splitfin, is a bony fish species in the goodeid family.

children.name: Zoogoneticus tequila
children.description: Zoogoneticus tequila, Tequila splitfin or simply Tequila fish, is a species of goodeid fish (family Goodeidae) from Mexico.

children.name: Goodea atripinnis
children.description: Goodea atripinnis, the blackfin goodea, is a species of killifish from the family Goodeidae.

children.name: Goodea luitpoldii
children.description: Goodea luitpoldii, the green goodea, is a species of killifish from the family Goodeidae which is endemic to the drainage basin of the Lerma River and the Grande de Santiago River in Mexico.
